title: transaction
description:
One synthetic transfer between two accounts already present in the system.

Both account columns are foreign keys: a transfer naming an unknown account is refused rather than creating one, because an account conjured from a transfer has no opening date, type or status and would score as a brand-new account forever.

Only COMPLETED is settled fund movement. Every monetary aggregate in the platform counts COMPLETED alone, and amounts are never summed across currencies.

reference.description: The transfer's identity in the outside world, and unique. It is how a complaint naming a transaction is matched to one, which is the whole of tier-1 correlation.

amount.description: Positive. Direction is carried by the sender and receiver columns, not by the sign, and a negative amount would be counted as a negative inflow. Accepted as a string so a caller can avoid float rounding; stored as a decimal.

occurred_at.description: Required. Every window, rate and velocity feature is defined relative to it, and a transfer with no time cannot be placed in a window at all.

metadata_json.description: Free-form synthetic context. Sanitised on ingestion: keys that look like secrets, tokens, raw identifiers, ground-truth labels, scenario ids or ring ids are dropped rather than stored.
